verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You've come to bring peace
To be Love
To be nearer to us

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You've come to bring life
To be Light
To shine brighter in us

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Our Deliverer
You are Saviour
In Your presence
We'll find our strength

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Over everything our redemption
God with us
You are God with us

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You've come
To be hope to this world
For Your honour and name

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You've come to take sin
To bear shame
And to conquer the grave

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
You are here
You are holy
We are standing in Your glory

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
You are here
You are holy
We are standing in Your glory, Lord
